subject: Sandbox keeps returning 429 while production is completely fine
body: Running our integration suite against sandbox and it falls over constantly with 429 responses about half way through. The exact same suite pointed at production never sees a single one. It is not a huge amount of traffic, maybe a few hundred calls over a couple of minutes with some parallelism. My assumption is our sandbox account is broken or has been throttled for some reason, since a test environment being stricter than prod makes no sense to me. Can someone check if there is something wrong with the key? Sample request id is req_44b1c9de.
